product.ta-1600-20-3.summary: The TA 1600/20-3 combined a fixed disk and a removable disk in one unit.
product.ta-1600-20-3.history: Triumph-Adler presented this /20 variant in 1982. In 1983 it offered it to medium-sized businesses that needed more storage capacity and flexibility.
product.ta-1600-20-3.technical.configura: The removable disk let operators take media out of the system. The offer listed two 8 MB gross volumes and a RAM upgrade to 1 MiB using a new module.
product.ta-1600-20-3.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1600-20-3.technical.limitatio: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
